meta.title: Add speed index to models
meta.body_summary: Introduce a SpeedIndex metric class and integrate it into model data mappings and sorting to support performance ranking of AI models.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor added SpeedIndex class; reviewer suggested raising ValueError for zero duration; fix adopted and merged with two approvals.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 847 changed lines across 24 files, this is a medium-sized change by absolute volume, concentrated in domain model and mapping. It matches a moderate incremental performance feature PR and merged after a minor error-handling fix.

review_details.concern_detail: guillaq suggested raising ValueError when `duration_seconds` is 0 instead of silently handling the division; the author changed the implementation to raise.
review_details.performance_claim: Add speed index to models for performance ranking.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Adding a structured metric class with domain logic and integrating into model sorting is within Cursor's capability; merge required a small error-handling fix after review.

detection_detail.code_reading: guillaq reviewed the `duration_seconds == 0` edge case and recommended raising ValueError.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Unit tests verify the calculation logic, but no performance benchmark or profiler evidence for speed ranking efficacy.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After the review comment, the author modified the code to raise ValueError; the fix was committed before merge.

core_change_summary.description: Introduced `SpeedIndex` class in `model_data.py` with a `from_experiment` factory method that computes speed index as output_tokens / duration_seconds. Extended model data mapping to include speed_index field and updated model sorting to use it. Multiple test files were adjusted to accommodate the new field.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Frontend changes were initially included but later reverted; the focus remained backend metric infrastructure.
change_trajectory: Initial cursoragent commit: added SpeedIndex class and integrated into model sorting, with frontend and many model details.
Follow-up commit by cursoragent simplified the speed index calculation.
Human maintainer yannbu reverted frontend changes and settings.json, then added experiment-based speed index values.
Multiple refinement commits: removed useless value, fixed model data, and added tests for speed index.
Review comment from guillaq: suggest raising ValueError for zero duration.
Final commit adopted the raise, and PR was merged after two approvals.

review_signals.summary: Suggested raising ValueError when `duration_seconds` is 0 instead of silently handling the division.
review_signals.action_taken: Author changed to raise ValueError in commit a6548df.

collaboration_trajectory: Cursor agent opened PR and made initial two commits with SpeedIndex and model integration.
Maintainer yannbu reverted unintended frontend changes and continued development with several refactoring and test commits.
Reviewer guillaq approved after suggesting error-handling improvement; yannbu acknowledged and applied the raise.
Second approval from jacekzimonski; merged after ~27 hours.
